title: The ETH Zurich University Archives will be presenting its resources on the subject of "Zwischen Hörsaal und Schützengraben: ETH-Angehörige im Ersten Weltkrieg" (Between the lecture theatre and the trenches: members of ETH Zurich involved in the First World War). The tour will be in German. Meeting point: ETH-Bibliothek, circulation desk ( main building , floor H). No registration necessary.
main_content:
The ETH Zurich University Archives will be presenting its resources on the subject of "Zwischen Hörsaal und Schützengraben: ETH-Angehörige im Ersten Weltkrieg" (Between the lecture theatre and the trenches: members of ETH Zurich involved in the First World War). The tour will be in German. Meeting point: ETH-Bibliothek, circulation desk ( main building , floor H). No registration necessary.

Dr Roman Rossfeld will make an appearance at the evening tour as a specialist in the history of the First World War.
